exposure: decreased UVBF normalized to estimated fetal weight
Fetal middle cerebral artery pulsatility index
outcome: Cesarean section for non-reassuring fetal status
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with late-onset small-for-gestational-age (SGA) babies delivered after 34 weeks' gestation
finding: Increased uterine artery pulsatility index and decreased UVBF normalized to estimated fetal weight are independently associated with placental underperfusion in late-onset SGA pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cases with placental histological findings indicative of placental underperfusion had a significantly higher incidence of Cesarean section for non-reassuring fetal status compared to those without such findings.
